<!--
Title format: fix(scope): short description. See CONTRIBUTING.md#title-format.
-->

## What happened

<!-- The observed wrong behaviour, and what was expected instead. -->

## Root cause

<!-- Why it happened, with file/line evidence where known. Write "Under investigation" if not yet identified. -->

## Fix

<!-- What the change does, and why this approach over the alternatives. -->

## Scope and impact

- **Areas:** <!-- e.g. playback, provider, UI, Windows, Android, docs -->
- **Platforms affected and tested:** <!-- Include OS/version, or say not runtime-tested. -->
- **Reproduction:** <!-- Steps or a link to the issue that demonstrate the bug before the fix. -->
- **Behavior or compatibility impact:** <!-- Include user-visible changes or known limitations. -->

## Validation

- **Checks/scenarios run:** <!-- Include commands and results; for contract fixes, the test that pins the behaviour. -->
- **Not run:** <!-- Explain why, or write "None." -->

## Evidence

<!-- Add logs, screenshots or measurements showing before/after. Remove credentials and personal data. -->

## Risks and follow-up

<!-- Note recovery/rollback needs, related gaps, or deferred work. Write "None" if not applicable. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] A regression test covers the fixed behaviour, or the missing check is explained above.
- [ ] Documentation and compatibility claims match the evidence.
- [ ] No secrets or unrelated changes are included.
